title: sprint status lists stale landings of deleted items by bare id with no age
goal: kbmon --status sprints names no landing whose item file is gone or whose land.step rows are older than the sprint panel's window by a bare id: such a landing is left out or shown with its age, so an id appears only where the operator acts

run: import re,subprocess,sys; p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/kbmon.py','--status','sprints'],capture_output=True,text=True); sys.exit(1 if p.returncode or re.search(r'landing [A-Z]{2}-[a-z0-9]{8}', p.stdout) else 0)
